name: camayoc_dora_open_changes
description: Work in progress (aegis-rb3): changes of one repository opened before the instant and neither merged nor abandoned at it, with their opening time; age is the instant minus opened. From aegis:ChangeEvent.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> SELECT ?change (MIN(?openedAt) AS ?opened) WHERE { GRAPH ?go { ?o a aegis:ChangeEvent ; aegis:changeId ?change ; aegis:changeRepository "{repository}" ; aegis:changeAction "created" ; aegis:occurredAt ?openedAt . } FILTER(STR(?openedAt) < "{end}") FILTER NOT EXISTS { GRAPH ?gc { ?x a aegis:ChangeEvent ; aegis:changeId ?change ; aegis:changeAction ?closing ; aegis:occurredAt ?closedAt . } FILTER(?closing IN ("merged", "abandoned") && STR(?closedAt) < "{end}") } } GROUP BY ?change ORDER BY ?opened

params.name: repository
params.description: change repository as owner/repo, e.g. scbrown/quipu
